Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: One press. One action. Just when it becomes ready.
Description: A strict one-shot smart input buffer with adaptive local timing, newest-input replacement, and fail-closed NoClippy, ReAction, and MOAction compatibility.
Changelog: Compatibility update: NoClippy support; guarded ReAction support with synthetic/delayed input features disabled; MOAction exclusions; newest-input replacement across owned plugin and native queues; exact queue ownership; multi-charge timing; and expanded cancellation guards.
